## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 37. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke records the sequence and the lineage. After overseeing Missouri State's transition from FCS to FBS, Beard took the Bears to a bowl game in their first season as a member of Conference USA — he didn't coach in it, as Coastal Carolina came calling and he hit the ground running in Conway. Burke notes Beard is Bobby Petrino's son-in-law and was at Missouri State for six seasons, first as the DC under Petrino and then as head coach when Petrino went to be the OC at Texas A&M. He then makes the point that ties the hire to the job: Beard, who was a defensive back at Western Kentucky, has been very successful in getting his players to get to the quarterback — and Coastal Carolina only had 19 sacks last season, their 80 sack yards the seventh-fewest. Just some food for thought.
